records.speaker: System
records.context: After Search finds that the expedition was attacked or otherwise lost sailors, the original effect removes sailors and gives the count before sailing resumes.
records.source_meaning: The system reports how many people were lost.
records.localization_note: The short notice clearly states the actual loss and works for singular or plural counts. Use regular-width digits in its existing substitution.
records.clean_Japanese:
水夫が%s人
減りました
